superiority: At least21 of31 paired target-boundary wins and upper95% two-sided bootstrap interval for median paired relative change below0.
noninferiority: Upper one-sided95% bootstrap bound of median paired relative change in the other boundary <=1% against the fixed IR242 executable. The fixed reference prevents successive1% concessions.
LLVM_investment_threshold: At least10% median paired processing reduction versus both fixed IR242 and identical-frontend/runtime IR264 Cranelift control. A second independently seeded predeclared cohort must confirm a successful first result before further backend expansion.
IR257_historical_results: Remain unselected under their historical joint gate; only this fresh prospective experiment can change selection.
other_requirements: Exact full outputs, source errors and finite budget behavior
Ownership/COW/aliases/publication/retry and independent loader proof rederivation
Actual emitted code/constants/stack and genuine same-Object identity
No deferred restoration charged to first evaluation
All first and adverse observations retained; no unchanged reruns to hunt wins
restoration_investment_threshold: Target at least1ms or10% restoration-instruction reduction, identified before representation change, with first evaluation and full process measured separately.
goal: Parity with fastest eligible measured Rust at both boundaries; this rule does not redefine completion
control_note: Existing IR264 native Object is byte-identical to its prior bundle; fresh host uses exactly the LLVM candidates runtime-only library and adapter, isolating backend from host/feature changes. Original adverse IR264 trial remains unchanged.
